title: Interparfums raises 2026 forecast and expects strong growth in 2027
summary: Interparfums SA, which manages global fragrance licenses for brands including Jimmy Choo, Montblanc, and Lacoste, as well as a portfolio of its own brands such as Rochas, Annick Goutal, and Solferino, announced on Thursday, November 19, that it had slightly raised its 2026 revenue target to EUR 880 million, up from EUR 870 million previously.
